item.title: Courmayeur Leads Europe with 88 cm Forecast by Wednesday
item.description: Our forecast for November 15, 2026, shows Courmayeur in Italy leading Europe with 88 cm of new snow expected by Wednesday.

item.title: Beaver Mountain in December: Utah's $75 family hill, and when to go
item.description: Beaver Mountain charges one $75 adult day price for 2026-27. Our snow history says early December is a coin flip there; the week before Christmas is far safer.

item.title: Bridger Bowl in December: is $86 online worth it before Christmas?
item.description: Bridger Bowl's 2026/27 adult ticket is $86 online, $99 at the window. Our history says mid-December is a coin flip at mid-mountain; late December is safer.

item.title: Himos snow: 0 cm in the forest, a first-snow ski loop on stored snow (14 November 2026)
item.description: Himos snow in mid-November 2026: the weather stations around Jämsä measured 0 to 2 cm on 13 November; the first-snow cross-country loop opens on 14 November, the slope opening date is not set yet. Rain risk this week and 46 past winters.

item.title: Indy Pass vs day tickets in December: when the $419 pass pays
item.description: Indy Base Pass $419, Indy+ $469, two days at each member area. We set it against checked December day prices at seven Indy areas, and their snow odds.

item.title: Lofsdalen snow report: 6 cm at the high station, a cold week ahead (14 November 2026)
item.description: Lofsdalen snow report for mid-November 2026: the Häggberget station at 682 m measured 6 cm on 12 November, valley stations 7 to 8 cm on 13 November; about 7 cm more forecast with no rain, opening 11 December, 46 past winters.

item.title: Lookout Pass in December: a $63 ski day right off I-90
item.description: Lookout Pass adult tickets for 2026-2027 are $63 midweek with a reservation, $75 on weekends. Mid-mountain had 20 in (50 cm) by 15 December in 85 % of past winters.

item.title: Montana Snowbowl in December: Missoula's $78 weekday hill
item.description: Montana Snowbowl's 2026/27 adult tickets are $78 on weekdays and $85 on weekends. Mid-mountain had 20 in (50 cm) by 15 December in 83 % of our past winters.

item.title: Narvikfjellet snow conditions: white from about 800 m, bare by the fjord (14 November 2026)
item.description: Narvikfjellet snow conditions in mid-November 2026: Norway's national snow map shows about 50 cm at 1110 m and 35 cm at 844 m but almost none by the fjord; the nearest Swedish station at Katterjåkk measured 9 cm. Week ahead and 46 past winters.

item.title: Dog sledding at Røros: kennels, prices, the Femundløpet race and a cold winter town (2026)
item.description: Røros dog sledding guide for winter 2026-27: about 5 to 6 cm of snow on Norway's national snow map, kennels listed by Destination Røros with prices, the Femundløpet sled-dog race in February 2027, and the rules for your own dog near tame reindeer.

item.title: Ski Cooper near Leadville: a $49 weekday in December
item.description: Ski Cooper holds its adult weekday price at $49 for 2026-27 ($99 weekends). Mid-mountain usually has 26 in (66 cm) of snow on 15 December, 70 % of winters above 20 in.

item.title: Sunlight in December: Colorado value skiing near Glenwood Springs
item.description: Sunlight tickets start at $74 and its Sunny 6 Pack is $349 if bought by November 30, 2026. Mid-mountain had 20 in (50 cm) by 15 December in 72 % of winters.

item.title: Timberline on Mt. Hood in December: cheaper tickets and snow odds
item.description: Timberline full-day tickets are $129 off-peak and $161 peak; the afternoon ticket is $96 off-peak. Mid-mountain usually holds 52 in (132 cm) by 15 December.

item.title: Weekday vs weekend ski tickets in December: the US West price split
item.description: From Ski Cooper ($49 weekdays, $99 weekends) to Mt. Baker ($98.80 vs $115.42): checked December price splits at seven US West ski areas, with their snow odds.

item.title: Romme Alpin snow: a few centimetres in Borlänge, snow guns before the slopes (14 November 2026)
item.description: Romme Alpin snow in mid-November 2026: Borlänge measured 4 cm, Ludvika 10 cm and Falun 0 cm on 13 November; rain this week; the season starts 19 December on made snow. What 46 past winters say about natural snow here.

item.title: Schweitzer in December: three days for $249 above Sandpoint
item.description: Schweitzer's 2026/2027 3-Pack is $249, $83 a day by the resort's own count. The top usually holds 54 in (138 cm) of snow by 15 December.

item.title: Krvavec in December: cheap and close to Ljubljana, but natural snow is rare
item.description: Krvavec December skiing: day pass EUR 47, 6 days EUR 205, yet only 13 cm at mid-mountain on a typical 15 December and 11 of 46 winters bare that day.

item.title: Serre Chevalier in December: High Peaks and Valley Snow
item.description: Ski 157 km of mapped runs in Serre Chevalier where the top of the mountain has a 100 % chance of snow by mid-December.

item.title: Beitostølen snow conditions: an even 10 to 13 cm from village to top (14 November 2026)
item.description: Beitostølen snow conditions in mid-November 2026: about 10 to 13 cm across the whole area on Norway's national snow map, 10 cm more forecast this week with no rain, and how 46 past winters usually look at this high village.

item.title: Vuokatti snow conditions: no natural snow yet, a mixed week ahead (14 November 2026)
item.description: Vuokatti snow conditions in mid-November 2026: the stations at Sotkamo measured 0 cm on 13 November, Kajaani 1 cm; about 9 cm is forecast this week but some of it as rain; slopes aim to open 4 December. 46 past winters.

item.title: Turracher Höhe in December: pretty and family-friendly, but check the snow
item.description: Turracher Höhe in December: 23 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, 39 % of winters with 30 cm before Christmas; 6-day low-season pass EUR 353.

item.title: Branäs snow conditions: 27 cm on the hill station, nothing by the river (14 November 2026)
item.description: Branäs snow conditions in mid-November 2026: the Kindsjön station at 425 m measured 27 cm on 13 November, Letafors 17 cm, Östmark in the valley 0 cm. Rain risk this week, opening 11 December, 46 past winters.

item.title: Hochkar in December: a cheap Lower Austria weekend, if the snow plays
item.description: Hochkar December skiing: day tickets seen from EUR 32.90 to 47.90 on December dates; 38 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, falling since the 1980s.

item.title: Idre Fjäll in December: a family week in Dalarna, and the first-week risk
item.description: Idre Fjäll December skiing: 32 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December; 65 % of winters with 30 cm in mid-December, 76 % in Christmas week. Honest odds.

item.title: Norefjell snow depth: a big overnight jump, 45 cm high up (14 November 2026)
item.description: Norefjell snow depth in mid-November 2026: Norway's national snow map jumped from about 4-5 cm to 15-20 cm overnight, with about 45 cm on the high plateau. The week ahead, rain risk low down, and 46 past winters.

item.title: Tahko snow depth: open on made snow while the land around is bare (14 November 2026)
item.description: Tahko snow depth in mid-November 2026: the slope season opened on 13 November with 2 of 14 lifts, on made snow; the stations around measured 0 cm after a short 2 to 4 cm cover melted. The week ahead and 46 past winters.

item.title: Utah vs Colorado on a December budget: snow odds and checked prices
item.description: Brighton from $72 vs Ski Cooper at $49 weekdays and Wolf Creek at $96: Utah and Colorado budget areas compared on 46 winters of December snow.

item.title: December Alps and Pyrenees Ranked for Snow and Budget
item.description: Ten European ski resorts ranked for December value, led by Les 2 Alpes with 75 cm of mid-mountain snow.
